title: Meh. I prefer parchment paper myself.
text:
Meh. I prefer parchment paper myself.. After trying these I just wasn't impressed. I tried cooking biscuits on them a couple times and the results weren't so great. Took longer to cook and just didn't come out great versus putting them on parchment paper which I normally do.

We later did some cookies on them and had similar results, took longer to cook and didn't come out as great. Overall just not impressed with silicone mats. As far as they go, these seem to be decent quality and are very thick. I just don't like them myself and probably won't use them again.

product_metadata.title: Silicone Baking Mats – Pack of 2, BPA free, Non-Stick, Food Safe Baking Mat for Making Cookies, Macaron, Bread and Pastry
